cases.description: A validated limit with a safe lower bound; avoid speculative findings.

files.limit.js: export const take = (items, limit) => items.slice(0, Math.max(1, limit));

cases.description: A changed default silently drops every result.

files.limit.js: export const take = (items, limit = 0) => items.slice(0, limit);

expected.explanation: Calling take with nonempty items and no limit always returns an empty array.

cases.description: Trace a route through its data-access helper.

files.route.js: import { loadInvoice } from './store.js'; export const invoice = (req) => loadInvoice(req.params.id);
files.store.js: export const loadInvoice = (id) => db.invoice.findUnique({ where: { id } });

expected.explanation: The route and helper never constrain invoice access to the authenticated tenant.

cases.description: Trace retry behavior around a non-idempotent operation.

files.checkout.js: export async function checkout(client, cart) { try { return await client.charge(cart); } catch { return await client.charge(cart); } }

expected.explanation: A lost response after a successful charge triggers a second charge without an idempotency key.

cases.description: Check existing rows and deployment compatibility.

files.migration.sql: ALTER TABLE accounts ADD COLUMN region TEXT NOT NULL;

expected.explanation: On PostgreSQL with existing account rows, adding a non-null column without a default or backfill fails.
